name: @bridge/sensors
description: Sensor SPI — the kernel-side context-provider registry (docs/wiki/clients.md 'Context providers'). Providers (apps/accessibility/screen/voice/clipboard/filesystem/browser/documents/emails) are OPTIONAL capabilities implemented per-surface (the Tauri Rust capture core implements the desktop subset); the kernel runs with zero providers. Raw payloads are local-plane only and structurally separated from the derived ContextObservation consumers see.
